---
title: "Projects"
description: "Search, filter, sort, and inspect engineering project evidence."
page-layout: full
listing:
  contents: "*.qmd"
  type: grid
  grid-columns: 2
  sort: "date desc"
  sort-ui: [date, title]
  filter-ui: [title, description, categories]
  categories: true
  fields: [image, title, description, date, categories]
  page-size: 12
---

A strong portfolio is selective. Keep work that demonstrates a meaningful
problem, your role, evidence, a revision, and an outcome. Use the filter box,
category list, or sort control to find a project.

To add a project, copy the appropriate file from `templates/` into this folder,
rename it with a short lowercase filename, and replace every prompt and sample
value.
